title: Lean 4 core library
summary: Reusable definitions and theorems for lists, arrays, natural numbers, and other core Lean data structures.
assumptions: Lean's logical foundations and the assumptions of each referenced theorem.
limitations: This is a discovery entry for Lean v4.35.0, not an independent audit of the whole Lean system.
Applicability to implementations in other languages is unknown.
reuse: Inspect individual theorem statements and pin the Lean toolchain before importing.

opportunities: Review or report core library issues upstream.
Contribute formal lemmas following upstream guidance.
